text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Hrm. I'm having a tough time with 
this part......
choice_data_list: You're working hard, huh.
You're working so hard, huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: 頑張ってるな
頑張ってるね

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Um... I was hoping to practice 
when there's no one else around...
choice_data_list: 1人で特訓？

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Taking lessons right next to the other 
Umamusume makes me feel kind of shy...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since I was little, I've seen 
plenty of Umamusume who belong on stage 
far more than I do."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
But... no matter how much I practice 
alone, I just can't shake this feeling 
that something's off...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe the stage really doesn't suit me 
after all...?"
choice_data_list:
Still, you were practicing the center 
choreography, weren't you?

Still, you were practicing the center 
choreography, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: でも、センターの振り付けを練習してたな
でも、センターの振り付けを練習してたね
choice_data_list_en: Still, you were practicing the center choreo, weren't you?
Still, you were practicing the center choreography, right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I know what I'm saying and what I'm 
doing don't match... but still...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: I think anyone can be the star!
The fans are waiting for your performance.
The fans are waiting for your performance.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: 誰もが主役になれると思う！
ファンは、君のパフォーマンスを待ってる
ファンは、貴方のパフォーマンスを待ってる
choice_data_list_en: I believe anyone can take center stage!
The fans are waiting for your performance.
The fans are eagerly awaiting your performance.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: 誰もが主役になれると思う！
ファンは、君のパフォーマンスを待ってる
ファンは、貴方のパフォーマンスを待ってる
choice_data_list_en: I believe anyone can take center stage!
The fans are waiting for your performance.
The fans are eagerly awaiting your performance.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...A "great Umamusume" is surely great on 
stage as well...
choice_data_list:
Don't hold back, let's dance freely and 
have fun!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: 気兼ねなく、のびのびと踊ってみよう！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a slightly lighter heart, Cheval 
Grand danced more confidently than usual, 
making it a fruitful practice session.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I can't just compare myself to others and 
get depressed...!
choice_data_list: I'll be watching from here as a fan!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-That's a little embarrassing... ...but 
yes... I'll do my best...!
choice_data_list: ファンとして、ここで見てるよ！
choice_data_list_en: I'll be watching right here as a fan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her spirits lifted, Cheval Grand danced 
with more vigor than usual, making for a 
truly productive practice session.
